# Beauty Wishlist by HS

> Beauty Wishlist by HS — Korean skincare and cosmetics store.

## Website

- Homepage: https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/
- Shop: https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/shop
- Categories: https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/categories
- Brands: https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/brand
- Sitemap: https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/sitemap.xml

## Products

Beauty Wishlist by HS offers Korean skincare and cosmetics.

Product pages follow:

https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/product/{product-slug}

Use individual product pages for current:
- Product names
- Product descriptions
- Product images
- Prices
- Availability
- Categories
- Ratings
- Product specifications

## Categories

Category pages follow:

https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/category/{category-slug}

Use category pages for discovering related products.

## Brand

Brand browsing:

https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/brand

## Product Data

Prefer individual product pages for current product information.

Do not assume prices or availability remain unchanged.

Use current page data whenever possible.

## Site Navigation

Homepage → Shop → Categories → Products

## Search Guidance

For product recommendations, prioritize:
1. Exact product pages
2. Current availability
3. Current pricing
4. Product descriptions
5. Relevant categories
6. Customer ratings

## Crawling

Public product and category pages may be indexed.

Account, checkout, cart, wishlist, and private customer areas should not be treated as public product information.

## Sitemap

https://beautywishlistbyhs.shop/sitemap.xml
